filepath = '/root/autodl-tmp/freige/training/rsft_generate.py'
with open(filepath) as f:
    content = f.read()

# 1a: Add --start_idx, --end_idx, --shard_id args after --quantize
old = '''    parser.add_argument("--quantize", action="store_true",
                        help="4-bit 量化 (default: off)")
    args = parser.parse_args()'''
new = '''    parser.add_argument("--quantize", action="store_true",
                        help="4-bit 量化 (default: off)")
    parser.add_argument("--start_idx", type=int, default=0,
                        help="Start document index (inclusive)")
    parser.add_argument("--end_idx", type=int, default=-1,
                        help="End document index (exclusive), -1 means all")
    parser.add_argument("--shard_id", type=str, default="",
                        help="Shard identifier, appended to output filename")
    args = parser.parse_args()'''
assert old in content, "PATCH 1a FAILED: --quantize block not found"
content = content.replace(old, new)

# 1b: Output filename based on shard_id
old = '    output_file = output_dir / "generations.jsonl"'
new = '''    if args.shard_id:
        output_file = output_dir / f"generations_shard{args.shard_id}.jsonl"
    else:
        output_file = output_dir / "generations.jsonl"'''
assert old in content, "PATCH 1b FAILED: output_file line not found"
content = content.replace(old, new)

# 1c: Data slicing after prepare_generation_data
old = '    items = prepare_generation_data(args.data_path, args.split, tokenizer)\n\n    completed = load_progress'
new = '''    items = prepare_generation_data(args.data_path, args.split, tokenizer)

    if args.end_idx > 0:
        items = items[args.start_idx:args.end_idx]
    elif args.start_idx > 0:
        items = items[args.start_idx:]
    logger.info("Shard slice: [%d:%s] -> %d documents",
                args.start_idx, str(args.end_idx) if args.end_idx > 0 else "end", len(items))

    completed = load_progress'''
assert old in content, "PATCH 1c FAILED: items block not found"
content = content.replace(old, new)

# 2: Fix diversity display bug
old = '        print(f"  mean_diversity: {mean_div:.1f}/{args.num_generations}")'
new = '        print(f"  mean_diversity: {mean_div * args.num_generations:.1f}/{args.num_generations}")'
assert old in content, "PATCH 2 FAILED: mean_diversity line not found"
content = content.replace(old, new)

with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("All patches applied successfully.")
